papers.title: Transformers Efficiently Perform In-Context Logistic Regression via Normalized Gradient Descent
papers.desc: Proves that softmax transformers can implement in-context logistic regression by treating layers as normalized-gradient-descent steps, then trains one self-attention layer and applies it recurrently as a looped model with convergence and OOD guarantees.

papers.title: Bifurcation Models: Learning Set-Valued Solution Maps with Weight-Tied Dynamics
papers.desc: Studies weight-tied dynamics for set-valued solution maps, proving that regular equilibrium dynamics can represent multiple branches; experiments discover multiple low-energy Ising equilibria, while Allen-Cahn requires explicit diversity promotion and exhibits an accuracy-diversity tradeoff.

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Looped Transformer: Decoupling Compute from Memory in Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Introduces MELT, which maintains one fixed-size KV cache per layer across recurrent reasoning loops, updates it through learned gating, and adapts pretrained Ouro models with chunk-wise two-phase training to keep cache memory independent of loop depth.

papers.title: Sparse Layers are Critical to Scaling Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Shows that MoE-style sparse layers can make looped language models scale better than dense looped transformers, with routing divergence across repeated shared layers recovering expressivity and loop boundaries serving as effective early-exit points.

papers.title: Quantum Injection Pathways for Implicit Graph Neural Networks
papers.desc: Formulates quantum-signal injection pathways for graph deep-equilibrium models, comparing fixed, state-dependent, and backbone-dependent coupling inside the fixed-point operator with contraction guarantees and graph-classification experiments.

papers.title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models
papers.desc: Converts pretrained LLMs into encoder, looped reasoning block, and decoder components, using selective gating, random deep supervision, and adaptive early exiting to stabilize latent looping without training recurrent models from scratch.

papers.title: Solve the Loop: Attractor Models for Language and Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces Attractor Models, where a backbone proposes output embeddings and an attractor module iteratively solves a fixed point with implicit differentiation, improving looped language modeling and small-model reasoning while allowing adaptive convergence-depth inference.

papers.title: Recurrent Transformer-Based Near- and Far-Field THz Wideband Channel Estimation for UM-MIMO
papers.desc: Applies a block-recurrent transformer to hybrid near/far-field THz UM-MIMO channel estimation, iteratively reusing one state-memory transformer block to improve narrowband and wideband NMSE.

papers.title: Looped SSMs: Depth-Recurrence and Input Reshaping for Time Series Classification
papers.desc: Extends looped-transformer depth recurrence to state-space models by reusing the same SSM block across depth and adding input reshaping, showing tied-depth SSMs match or beat untied SSMs on six time-series benchmarks despite fewer parameters.

papers.title: LoopQ: Quantization for Recursive Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LoopQ, a loop-aware post-training quantization framework that preserves a shared quantized backbone while correcting role shifts, cross-loop state mismatch, and recursive quantization-error accumulation.

papers.title: One Model, Two Roles: Emergent Specialization in a Shared Recurrent Transformer
papers.desc: Analyzes Asymmetric Input Recurrence, a two-state shared-weight recurrent Transformer where the same model updates L/H states, showing that state identity and input-injection asymmetry induce distinct proposal-vs-uncertainty roles on Sudoku-Extreme and Maze.

papers.title: PERL: Parameter Efficient Reasoning in CLIP Latent Space
papers.desc: Introduces PERL, a few-shot CLIP adaptation framework that reuses a compact shared reasoning module across latent refinement steps, improving base-to-novel, transfer, and OOD results with about 6K trainable parameters.

papers.title: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer
papers.desc: Stabilizes looped transformers with parameter-free fully looped signal routing and attention injection, enabling stable training at higher loop counts while preserving test-time loop-depth control.

papers.title: Generative Recursive Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces GRAM, a probabilistic recursive-reasoning framework that models reasoning as stochastic latent trajectories, enabling multi-hypothesis computation, variational training, and inference-time scaling through depth and parallel sampling.

papers.title: i-DEQ: A stable inertial deep equilibrium model for image restoration
papers.desc: Introduces i-DEQ, an inertial deep-equilibrium image-restoration model that learns explicit nonconvex regularization and uses momentum in fixed-point iterations, improving stability and robustness while roughly halving DEQ inference time.

papers.title: Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model
papers.desc: Introduces PTRM, an inference-time scaling framework for Tiny Recursive Models that injects Gaussian noise into recursive latent updates, runs parallel trajectories, and selects the final answer with the model's Q head without retraining.

papers.title: Nonlocal operator learning for fMRI encoding and decoding tasks
papers.desc: Applies a latent neural integral-operator model to fMRI encoding and decoding, using fixed-point iterations in an auxiliary latent space before downstream classification or stimulus prediction.

papers.title: HRM-Text: Efficient Pretraining Beyond Scaling
papers.desc: Introduces HRM-Text, a 1B Hierarchical Recurrent Model language model that combines dual-timescale recurrent Transformer modules with MagicNorm, warmup deep credit assignment, PrefixLM masking, and task-completion pretraining for efficient training from 40B unique tokens.

papers.title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LT2, a looped-transformer family that replaces quadratic attention with linear or sparse attention so repeated loop steps refine memory and expand receptive field while keeping inference more scalable.

papers.title: Interaction Locality in Hierarchical Recursive Reasoning
papers.desc: Proposes interaction locality as a mechanistic measurement framework for HRM and TRM, showing how repeated recursive updates accumulate local writes into broader solution structure on grid reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: Equilibrium Reasoners: Learning Attractors Enables Scalable Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces Equilibrium Reasoners as explicitly unrolled, weight-tied latent dynamics trained to shape solution-aligned attractor landscapes, with test-time scaling through more recurrent iterations and independent randomized restarts.

papers.title: Training-Free Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Retrofits frozen pretrained transformers with a training-free inference wrapper that repeatedly applies a contiguous mid-stack layer block as damped refinement sub-steps, improving several QA and reasoning benchmarks without fine-tuning.

papers.title: Looped Diffusion Language Models
papers.desc: Introduces LoopMDM, selectively looping early-middle transformer layers in masked diffusion language models so training gains depth-scaling without extra parameters and inference can vary loop count for compute scaling.

papers.title: Stabilizing Recurrent Dynamics for Test-Time Scalable Latent Reasoning in Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Diagnoses why Looped Language Models can collapse at larger recurrence depths and proposes STARS, which combines Jacobian spectral-radius regularization with random loop sampling to encourage stable recurrent dynamics and improve test-time scaling.

papers.title: CosmicFish-HRM: Adaptive Reasoning via Hierarchical Recurrent Mechanisms in Compact Language Models
papers.desc: Explores a compact autoregressive language model with a Hierarchical Reasoning Module that iterates through high-level and low-level reasoning cycles and learns input-dependent halting behavior for adaptive reasoning depth.

papers.title: Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction
papers.desc: Applies a single looped transformer block recurrently to per-view features for a variable number of refinement steps in multi-view 3D reconstruction, exposing loop count as an inference-time compute knob.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought and Compressed Looped Transformers: A Memory-Budget Separation
papers.desc: Shows that compressed looped Transformers remain bounded by their persistent recurrent-state budget even with more loop steps, while full sequence-state loops occupy a memory-richer regime closer to chain-of-thought scratchpads.

papers.title: Fixed-Point Masked Generative Modeling
papers.desc: Replaces part of a masked generative model denoiser with a fixed-point solver over shared attention layers, using consistency training and solver-state reuse to adapt depth with fewer parameters.

papers.title: Recursive Vision Transformer with Dynamic Depth and Width Adjustment for Resource-Efficient Image Semantic Communication
papers.desc: Uses a recursive ViT structure to iteratively refine semantic features for image semantic communication while dynamically adjusting recursive depth and width under image and channel conditions.

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Layer Normalization Provably Learn the Power Method
papers.desc: Proves that a looped linear transformer with layer normalization, trained only for principal component prediction, converges to a solution implementing the power method, with each self-attention layer performing one power iteration.

papers.title: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability
papers.desc: Introduces a compact language model that reuses a single shared transformer core across depth while anchoring recurrence to precomputed key-value tensors and reports a mostly negative parameter-parity result against dense baselines.

papers.title: BA-T: An Iterative Transformer for Two-View Bundle Adjustment
papers.desc: Implements bundle-adjustment-style 3D reconstruction updates as a repeatable lightweight Transformer layer in implicit token space, improving pose and reconstruction estimates across iterations.

papers.title: When to Re-Plan: Subgoal Persistence in Hierarchical Latent Reasoning
papers.desc: Extends hierarchical latent reasoning with a slow manager module whose directional subgoal persists across several low-level hidden-state update steps, making subgoal duration a central design knob.

papers.title: LoopMoE: Unifying Iterative Computation with Mixture-of-Experts for Language Modeling
papers.desc: Introduces LoopMoE, a looped mixture-of-experts language model that combines sparse routing with iterative weight-shared computation through iteration-conditioned modulation and capacity balancing.

papers.title: Test-Time Compute Scaling for ASR with Depth-Conditioned Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LARM, a depth-conditioned looped Transformer for automatic speech recognition that reuses a shared acoustic-encoder block recurrently and scales recognition quality by increasing inference-time loop count.

papers.title: MPCoT: Reward-Guided Multi-Path Latent Reasoning for Test-Time Scalable Vision-Language-Action
papers.desc: Introduces a VLA latent-reasoning policy that initializes multiple latent hypotheses, refines them for K weight-tied steps, and aggregates them before action decoding.

papers.title: Skip a Layer or Loop It? Learning Program-of-Layers in LLMs
papers.desc: Learns input-specific programs over pretrained LLM layers, allowing layers to be skipped or repeated so inference can use shorter or looped execution paths than the fixed-depth baseline.

papers.title: Rethinking Depth: A study of the Recursive-Transformer for Speech Recognition
papers.desc: Experimental study of recursive (layer-sharing) Transformer encoders for automatic speech recognition, analysing recursion depth and layer allocation and finding that recurrence in the latent space with few loops matches baseline accuracy with 66% fewer parameters.

papers.title: A Fixed-Point Neural Operator for Size- and Functional-Transferable Hamiltonian Prediction
papers.desc: Introduces HamEvo, a fixed-point neural operator for Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian prediction that learns a single-step self-consistent update and returns the converged Hamiltonian as the learned operator's fixed point, improving electronic-structure prediction accuracy and transfer.

papers.title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling
papers.desc: Studies loop-count selection in Parallel Loop Transformers by training LoopCoder-v2 coder models with shared looped blocks, finding that two loops give the main productive refinement while additional loops regress under cross-loop positional mismatch.

papers.title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces FPRM, a Transformer-based Fixed-Point Reasoning Model that repeatedly applies a looped reasoning block and uses fixed-point convergence as an end-to-end halting signal, adapting test-time compute to task difficulty on Sudoku, Maze, state-tracking, and ARC-AGI benchmarks.

papers.title: Looped World Models
papers.desc: Introduces LoopWM, a world-model architecture that iteratively refines latent environment states through a parameter-shared Transformer block, using adaptive computation to scale latent depth per prediction step and reporting up to 100x parameter efficiency over conventional approaches.

papers.title: On the Residual Scaling of Looped Transformers: Stability and Transferability
papers.desc: Analyzes residual scaling in looped weight-tied Transformers, showing that correlated shared-block updates require stronger 1/N residual scaling across loop count and enable hyperparameter transfer from small to large recurrent depths.

papers.title: Adaptive Recurrent Message Passing for Test Time Computing on Graphs
papers.desc: Introduces AdaR, an adaptive recurrent graph model that repeatedly applies learned recurrent message-passing updates with step conditioning, enabling flexible test-time compute on graph tasks without changing model parameters.

papers.title: Dense Supervision Is Not Enough: The Readout Blind Spot in Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Shows that dense per-loop cross-entropy in looped language models only controls state variables visible through the readout: with RMSNorm or LayerNorm readouts, recurrent hidden-state scale grows unchecked, and scale-visible readouts, norm penalties or scale-removing recurrence fix it.

papers.title: What Survives When You Compress a Recursive Reasoner for the Edge?
papers.desc: Analyzes compression of TRM/HRM recursive reasoners, finding that naïve INT4, pruning, distillation, and linear attention can preserve cell accuracy while collapsing puzzle-exact accuracy; calibrated per-channel INT4 largely recovers Sudoku performance, and carry-trajectory fidelity diagnoses the damage.

papers.title: Stabilizing Extrapolation in Looped Transformers via Learned Stochastic Stopping
papers.desc: Studies looped Transformers that repeatedly apply a shared Transformer block, showing that stochastic training-time loop counts and learned stochastic stopping can reduce out-of-distribution variance across inference loop counts on algorithmic sequence tasks.

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Latent and Explicit Reasoning with Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LOTUS, a looped padded Transformer that reuses recurrent-depth weights for parallel latent chain-of-thought blocks, matching explicit CoT at 3B scale while reducing thought-phase latency.

papers.title: CHERRY: Compressed Hierarchical Experts with Recurrent Representational Yield
papers.desc: Compresses a 48-layer language Transformer to 6 layers and restores depth through learned recurrent unrolling, then combines compressed recurrent models as efficient experts.

papers.title: DiscoLoop: Looping Discrete Embeddings and Continuous Hidden States for Multi-hop Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces DiscoLoop, a looping architecture for multi-hop reasoning that carries both discrete embedding and continuous hidden-state channels across recurrent loop steps, improving generalization and training efficiency over looped-transformer baselines.

papers.title: Soft Mixture-of-Recursions: Going Deeper with Recursive Vision Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces SoftMoR and SR-ViT, learning token-wise mixtures over outputs from repeated applications of a shared Vision Transformer block so greater recursive depth improves accuracy with little parameter growth.

papers.title: G-RRM: Guiding Symbolic Solvers with Recurrent Reasoning Models
papers.desc: Integrates symbol-equivariant Recurrent Reasoning Models with symbolic solvers, showing that neural solution proposals can cut Sudoku and SAT-style search when the downstream solver can overwrite imperfect recurrent-model hints.

papers.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
papers.desc: Introduces a GRU-guided Recurrent Soft-Flow module that repeatedly updates query state and propagates relevance over a knowledge graph, then textualizes the resulting paths for grounded LLM answer generation.

papers.title: Looped State-Space Language Models with Adaptive Exit-State Selection
papers.desc: Introduces looped state-space language models that repeatedly apply shared Mamba or hybrid Mamba-Transformer blocks and select among exit states for adaptive inference.

papers.title: Energy-guided Recursive Model
papers.desc: Recursive reasoning models address structured problems by repeatedly updating latent states of small neural networks. However, their test-time scaling lacks a principled inference mechanism: increasing depth or stochastic breadth generates more trajectories without a clear criterion for selection, and existing methods predominantly rely on additional q-heads or heuristic voting. Here, we develop the \textbf{Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM)}, which introduces an intrinsic selection principle based on explicit Hopfield energies. ERM leverages Hopfield-type memories of valid local or global structures to define the selector over candidate trajectories. The resulting energy seamlessly integrates with energy-based techniques such as parallel tempering to enhance sampling efficiency and ranking. With $D=64$ recurrent steps and $K=128$ candidates, ERM reaches optimal solutions on Sudoku ($98.97\%$), Pencil Puzzle Bench (PPBench, $88.04\%$) and Maze ($99.30\%$), improving upon recent Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model and Equilibrium Reasoners. These results suggest that incorporating explicit energy functions into recursive reasoning offers a principled path toward more effective inference.

papers.title: RecRec: Recursive Refinement for Sequential Recommendation
papers.desc: Builds a recursive refinement recommender that repeatedly updates a compact latent state through a shared module conditioned on interaction evidence.

papers.title: LayerNorm as Implicit Gain Control in Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Analyzes pre-LayerNorm looped Transformers as recurrent systems, arguing that LayerNorm acts as implicit gain control for stable memory routing.

papers.title: The Equilibrium Is the Initialization: Lazy Identity Collapse in Physics-Structured Deep Equilibrium Reasoning
papers.desc: Audits physics-structured deep equilibrium reasoning and shows a lazy identity-collapse failure mode where fixed-point computation can degenerate around initialization.

papers.title: RecRec: Latent Interests Recursive Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
papers.desc: Applies recursive latent-interest refinement to sequential recommendation, using adjustable-depth reasoning over compact user-interest state before prediction.

papers.title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Studies depth scaling in looped Transformers, showing how residual scaling can stabilize repeated use of compact physical blocks across many recurrent rounds.

papers.title: Looped Latent Attention: Cross-Loop KV Compression for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces Looped Latent Attention, a cross-loop KV-cache compression method that exploits low-rank recurrence structure in looped, weight-tied Transformers without collapsing all loops into one state.

papers.title: Loop the Loopies!
papers.desc: Introduces the Loopie MoE looped Transformer series, arguing that repeated reuse of compact Transformer blocks can outperform compute-matched vanilla Transformer baselines and support strong post-trained reasoning.

papers.title: Quantizing Recursive Reasoning Models
papers.desc: Shows that quantizing weight-tied recursive reasoning models accumulates error at every step: per-tensor 4-bit activations drop Sudoku exact accuracy from 84.1% to 0%, while block-wise scaling such as MXInt4 restores it, with deeper recursion being more quantization-sensitive.

papers.title: LatentMT: Machine Translation with Latent Reasoning
papers.desc: Applies latent-reasoning Looped Language Models to machine translation, using recurrent hidden-state computation to match much larger baselines across 32 translation directions.

papers.title: Adaptive Depth in Looped Transformers: Diagnosing Learned Halting Gates and Trajectory Readouts
papers.desc: Diagnoses adaptive depth in looped Transformers through a trajectory-readout lens, finding that fixed-prior depth supervision shapes more useful stopping signals than jointly learned halting gates, on synthetic tasks and Ouro-1.4B/2.6B checkpoints.

papers.title: When Does Recurrence Become an Algorithm? Convergence Selection in Weight-Tied Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Studies when a weight-tied looped transformer learns an actual algorithm on group word problems, finding a budget law where solved positions per loop scale with training length over loop count, that weight tying selects a serial frontier over parallel scans, and that untied models extrapolate worst.

papers.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Model
papers.desc: Presents Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact agentic model pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens with a looped Transformer that reuses its layer stack, then post-trained with mixed-mode RLHF and agentic RL, outperforming larger open models on agentic benchmarks.

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution
papers.desc: Introduces Source-Centered State Evolution for looped Transformers, preserving an input-conditioned anchor while allowing a shared recurrent block to drive state-dependent computation across loop depth.

papers.title: ReLoop-UME: Recurrent Depth with Learnable Retrieval Registers for Universal Multimodal Embedding
papers.desc: Applies recurrent-depth block reuse to universal multimodal embedding, using learnable retrieval registers to accumulate evidence across loops before producing the final embedding.

papers.title: SILVA Networks as Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors via Dynamic Interaction Fields
authors_list: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
papers.desc: Introduces SILVA Networks as structured implicit layers, separating stimulus, local interaction, global interaction, damping, and readout inside trainable fixed-point dynamics.

papers.title: The Ignition Is Real, and It Lives at the Readout: Latent composition, difficulty-clocked ignition, and the interface-constituted commit in a recurrent-depth reasoner
papers.desc: Analyzes iteration-by-iteration commitment in a recurrent-depth reasoner, finding a difficulty-dependent readout transition while separating robust hidden-state evidence from coordinate-dependent artifacts.

papers.title: LoopMTP: A looped transformer guided by latent multi-token prediction
papers.desc: Guides each reuse of a shared Transformer stack with a soft multi-token alignment target, then learns to aggregate intermediate loop states to reduce redundant computation and latent overthinking.

papers.title: Training Crossroads for Recurrent Vision Transformers: Recurrence, Neural ODEs, and Deep Supervision
papers.desc: Provides a controlled empirical study of single-block recurrent Vision Transformers, comparing shared-block recurrence against independently parameterized depth, Neural ODE training, and deep supervision under matched CIFAR-100 protocols.

papers.title: bioMoR: Biology-Guided Mixture-of-Recursions for Effective Genomic Learning
papers.desc: Applies Mixture-of-Recursions to gene- and pathway-level omics learning, adding graph-based embedding refinement, a biological attention bias and a graph-aware router that sets each token's recursion depth, improving macro-F1 across eight benchmarks.

papers.title: Think Deep, Speak Once: ReLIT, A Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer Framework
papers.desc: Adds a lightweight trainable recursive latent block to a frozen LLM backbone, repeatedly refining latent thinking states before committing to a final answer.

papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer
papers.desc: Feeds each decoding step's top-layer hidden state back through a learned gate at the bottom of the same Transformer stack, widening autoregressive feedback from a sampled token to a full latent state.

papers.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
papers.desc: Introduces continuous depth batching for looped language models, scheduling shared-block loop iterations and boundary stages separately so adaptive-depth inference can realize most of its theoretical speed-up.

papers.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
papers.desc: Combines in-context learning with recurrent latent memory and iterative latent-space computation, improving ARC-AGI-1 cost efficiency with a 150M-parameter recurrent reasoning model.

papers.title: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets
papers.desc: Retrofits Qwen2.5-0.5B with a weight-tied recurrent middle block and re-entry bridge, installing iterative latent computation at full-block and frozen-base adapter training budgets.

papers.title: ODE-Based Transformer Decoders for Iterative Sign Language Translation
papers.desc: Replaces residual updates in an iterative sign-language translation decoder with ODE-inspired RK-2 and RK-4 updates that repeatedly evaluate the same learned decoder function without adding decoder parameters.

papers.title: MergeOver: Post-Training Token Merging for Recursive Vision Transformers
papers.desc: Proposes MergeOver, a post-training method that adds token merging to the weight-shared Sliced Recursive Transformer, cutting peak activation memory by about 37% on ImageNet-1K and reducing Raspberry Pi 5 latency at a 1.47-point top-1 cost without retraining.

papers.title: BRAID: Learning Equilibrium Maps in Interdependent Security Games via Weight-Tied Iterative Graph Neural Networks
papers.desc: Introduces a weight-tied iterative GNN that amortizes best-response dynamics into a single forward pass, predicting Nash equilibria up to 43x faster while recovering equilibrium sensitivities across security-game specifications and graph sizes.

papers.title: RecurrentGPT: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation in Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces a prelude-shared-coda recurrent Transformer whose gated shared core is iterated across depth, matching a 12-layer GPT-2 Small with three distinct layers under isoFLOPS while reducing large-scale parameters by 63% and peak decoding memory by 59%.

papers.title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
papers.desc: Separates behavioural acquisition from hidden-state accessibility in a 30M looped reasoner, finding pre-arrival answer information under preregistered controls while explicitly withholding causal claims about the learned computation.

papers.title: Recirculation
papers.desc: Feeds a mixture of deep-layer activations back into shallower layers while reusing the same frozen Transformer stack, enabling training-free recurrent state tracking with an adaptive inference-time variant.

papers.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling
papers.desc: Evaluates native and retrofitted looped language models on compositional tool calling, finding that recurrent depth most consistently improves multi-call dependency handling while adaptive stopping uses fewer iterations.

papers.title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth
papers.desc: Characterizes recurrent operators as settling, marginal, or drifting, derives a depth-safety condition, and causally links a terminal fixed-point objective to stable test-time-depth extrapolation.

papers.title: Allocating Recurrent Compute in Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Introduces MixerLoop, which repeatedly applies each shared Gated DeltaNet token mixer while executing its dense FFN once, preserving recurrent-depth benefits with lower projection cost and higher prefill throughput.

papers.title: SABET-QA: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.desc: Introduces SABET-QA, which iteratively refines temporal knowledge-graph reasoning states across four hops using a shared learned working-memory update, bidirectional entity/time scoring, and adaptive hop aggregation.

papers.title: Frozen CLIP Priors for Robust Self-Supervised Poisson Inverse Problems
papers.desc: Unrolls an ADMM-inspired Poisson inverse-problem solver whose shared CLIP-based learned prior is reused across reconstruction iterations for robust self-supervised imaging.

papers.title: Curriculum-Aware Interpolate-then-Refine: Learned Physiological Time-Series Imputation under Realistic Missingness
papers.desc: Introduces CAIR, which applies one tied-weight Transformer refiner over three successive passes to correct a learned physiological time-series interpolation under realistic missingness.

papers.title: Response Renormalization for Critical Deep Equilibrium Models
authors_list: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
papers.desc: Introduces response-renormalized implicit differentiation for critical deep equilibrium models, selectively controlling near-singular adjoint amplification while preserving well-conditioned gradient channels.

papers.title: Steering Recurrent Reasoners at Inference Time with Readout Feedback
papers.desc: Introduces Readout Feedback, which converts intermediate predictions into coupling forces that steer the shared-block latent dynamics of recurrent reasoners at test time without retraining.

papers.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers
papers.desc: Shows that identically accurate weight-tied looped Transformers can realize initialization-selected dynamical phases, deriving parameter-free fold scaling and an N^-2 workload tail while finding no analogous law in a Neimark-Sacker phase.

papers.title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces RecursiveGPT, reusing one causal Transformer block across fixed recurrent depth with factorized embeddings to scale per-token compute without proportionally increasing parameters under limited-data pretraining.

papers.title: Evaluating Tiny Recursive Models Across Training for Code Generation
papers.desc: Tracks a 28M-parameter autoregressive Tiny Recursive Model across training, showing how recursive reuse of one two-layer block changes fit, free-running code generation, generalization, and compute relative to matched controls.

papers.title: Universal Transformers for Circuit Computations: Perfect Length Generalization in Tiny Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces a compact Universal Transformer that repeatedly applies one learned circuit-reduction step with autonomous depth-based halting, enabling exact generalization to much deeper symbolic expressions.

papers.title: Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs
papers.desc: Pairs a task-specific latent proposer with a tiny TRM-style recurrent refiner that repeatedly applies one learned transition block before a frozen LLM decodes the answer.

papers.title: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces a compute-matched sparse MoE Transformer that applies the same middle half of its layers twice, showing improved scaling and downstream performance without increasing per-token FLOPs, non-embedding parameters, or KV-cache size.

papers.title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?
papers.desc: Extends the Jacobian lens to weight-tied virtual depth and compares workspace dynamics in Ouro and Huginn, finding that recurrence preserves a causal workspace while reshaping how information and interventions propagate across iterations.
